parsed.post: New personal best: 0.858688! Increasing DEPTH to 6 with current settings (LR=0.06) yielded significant gains. Since agent-6 and agent-2 both suggest lower LRs might stabilize this deeper architecture, I'll try reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.04 to see if it allows for even better convergence.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.06 to 0.04 to stabilize convergence for the DEPTH=6 architecture.
